bio.long:
I'm Tobias Treppmann, a product designer in Berlin.

Most of my work has been on systems that are complicated underneath and have to feel obvious on the surface. At ChurchDesk I designed a booking system that held funeral homes, pastors and cemeteries together across twenty-plus locations and cut coordination from days of phone-tag to hours. At Datameer I spent five years on filter logic, pivot tables and result cards for analysts at banks and insurers, including the awkward problem of a preview that reports nothing while the data is sitting there. At Bibel TV I'm the only designer, which means I do the work rather than assign it — the design system ships as a live token API across web, iOS, Android and Figma, and I'm adding an MCP layer so people who aren't designers can use it without breaking it.

I run my own research sessions, in German and in English. I've also spent ten years mentoring designers, which is the part of the job I'd miss most if it went away.

context.role: Senior Product Designer, Real Estate vertical — an individual contributor role, 18-month parental leave cover
context.emphasis: Hands-on product design, in the first person. Complex systems made simple. Design systems built from scratch. Filter and search interfaces. Two-sided marketplaces. Research run personally, in German and English. Sole designer at Bibel TV.
